requestBody.query: SELECT campaign.resource_name, campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.campaign_budget, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign WHERE campaign.id > 0 AND campaign.status = PAUSED AND segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS
